item.title: First-year Aggie head coach makes homecoming trip in loss to Alabama
item.description: Texas A&M head basketball coach and Birmingham native Bucky McMillan made his return to the Yellowhammer State Wednesday night when his Aggies came to Tuscaloosa to take on Alabama.
